subject: Partial authorization failures observed - hosted inference (us-west)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@evermart.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partial authorization failures observed - hosted inference (us-west)

Hi Alice —

Quick heads up: our monitoring flagged a spike in 401/authorization failures for requests routed to the hosted inference pool in us-west starting ~09:05 PDT. We believe this is impacting a subset of EverMart requests that use short-lived session tokens (your footprint matches the token pattern).

What we know so far:
- Window: ~09:05 — 09:40 PDT (ongoing as of this note)
- Symptom: intermittent 401 responses for inference calls (not all requests).
- Surface impacted: hosted inference API endpoints (us-west), streaming and non-streaming paths.

Immediate actions we have taken:
- Opened ops ticket RDI-2025-845 and engaged infra on-call.
- Pushed a temporary routing change to divert traffic to a fallback auth verifier while we triage.
- Marked incident on our status page (link below).

Ask of you: can you share a representative request/response trace (request id/timestamp) if you have it? I attached a short server-side sample we captured.

Status page: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2025-10-01-auth-failures
Ops ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/845

We will follow up within 30 minutes with a clearer mitigation/update. Apologies for the disruption — we know this is impacting your users.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdi_error_sample_0912.txt (excerpt of 401 responses)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial authorization failures observed - hosted inference (us-west)

Monica / team —

Quick internal triage update from infra on-call (summary):
- Root cause (preliminary): a certificate rotation/control-plane change caused a small window where token validation calls returned transient errors; service falling back to stricter validation rejected a subset of short-lived session tokens.
- Impact: intermittent 401s for requests that relied on token refresh during the rotation window; not all tokens.
- Mitigation applied at 09:30 PDT: reverted the new verifier config and enabled the legacy fallback path. This reduced failures to noise by 09:40 PDT.
- Next steps: engineers will run the replay and extend token acceptance window for 1 hour to allow in-flight refreshes to complete. Postmortem and RCA to follow.

Operational notes for comms:
- We should publish a concise status update to customers acknowledging the partial auth failures, summarizing mitigation, and committing to a follow-up detailed RCA in 72 hours.
- Offer a goodwill credit / SLA evaluation to impacted customers; coordinate with Lauren and finance if EverMart requests a formal credit.

I've attached the ops ticket id for tracking. I recommend Monica include the ticket link in the customer follow-up.

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 11:02:10 -0700
Subject: Update: Partial authorization failures (us-west) — mitigation applied and next steps

Hi Alice —

Following up with the mitigation summary and next actions.

What we did:
- Reverted the new auth verifier config and re-enabled the legacy fallback path (09:30 PDT).
- Expanded acceptance window for short-lived tokens for one hour to allow in-flight refreshes to succeed.
- Confirmed that 401 error rate dropped to baseline by ~09:40 PDT for EverMart traffic.

Current status:
- Incident marked as "identified / mitigated" on our status page: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2025-10-01-auth-failures
- Root cause investigation in progress; preliminary cause: control-plane verifier rotation created a transient validation mismatch.
- Engineers will run a full replay and provide an RCA within 72 hours.

What you can expect from us:
- A concise postmortem (RCA) delivered to your team within 72 hours with timeline, corrective actions, and verification steps.
- If you feel EverMart saw measurable user-impact, we are prepared to evaluate a customer credit against SLA and will coordinate via Lauren.
- I am available for a quick call if you'd like more detail; propose 11:30 PDT today or tomorrow morning.

Again, sincere apologies for the disruption — we recognize how important reliability is for your flows. Please reach out if you want the engineers to pull any additional traces.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
